# MultiClaude

> MultiClaude is a free, open source (Apache 2.0) macOS menu bar app that runs several Claude desktop accounts side by side on one Mac, one profile per account, each started with its own `--user-data-dir` folder. It routes Google and SSO sign-in to the right window, reopens profiles after Claude updates itself, runs Claude Code per account with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, copies MCP servers between profiles, counts Claude Code tokens per account, keeps the Mac awake, and ships a Go command line tool, `multiclaude`. Current version 1.11 (2026-11-18). Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

- Platforms: macOS 15 or later, Apple silicon and Intel (universal binary).
- Install: `brew install --cask quentincar0n/tap/multiclaude`, or the zip from GitHub Releases (not notarized: right-click, Open the first time).
- Requires the Claude desktop app in /Applications. MultiClaude launches it unchanged.
- App: Swift (main.swift, Groups.swift), no dependencies. CLI: Go, in cli/.
- Homepage: https://quentincar0n.github.io/multiclaude/
